data.name: Delive R us
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Delive-R’ Us – where your hustle determines your lifestyle.
You’ve just been laid off, rent is due, and you're not going back to the 9-to-5 grind. Time to take control of your future and earn cash through gig work — one chaotic delivery at a time.

Delive-R’ Us is a quirky single-player delivery driver simulation game that blends fast-paced gameplay with life management mechanics. Accept or decline jobs through your in-game phone, then hop on your moped to navigate city streets, collect grocery items, and race to make timely deliveries. The faster and more accurate you are, the better the tips — but if you're too slow or sloppy, customers will cancel and your gig rating will plummet.

Between shifts, use your earnings to upgrade your tiny apartment and improve your quality of life. A better lifestyle helps you perform better on the job, creating a satisfying gameplay loop of hustle and reward.

Core Features:

  • 🛵 Delivery Driver Simulation – Accept or reject orders via your mobile app, then rush to pick up and deliver items before time runs out.

  • 🛒 In-Store Shopping – Navigate the supermarket in first-person to grab the right products before the customer cancels.

  • 💸 Gig Economy Pressure – Late deliveries or too many failed orders will get you terminated. Stay sharp!

  • 🧠 Strategic Time Management – Balance speed with precision: wrong items or poor navigation cost you time and money.

  • 🏠 Apartment Upgrades – Spend your tips to furnish and improve your home, increasing your overall happiness and job efficiency.

  • 🎮 Short Sessions, Long-Term Goals – Designed for bite-sized play sessions with long-term progression.

Delive-R’ Us captures the frantic, unpredictable energy of gig work while giving players agency to shape their journey. Will you become a five-star delivery legend — or just another burnout in the city?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit) or newer
  • Processor: 1.8 GHz or faster processor
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 460/Radeon HD 5850/Intel HD 4600 with at least 1024 MB video RAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

Recommended:

  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit) or newer
  • Processor: 2.8 GHz or faster processor
  • Memory: 3 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
